articles.title: Should You Continue Your SIP When Markets Fall? | 3 Reasons to Stay Invested
articles.description: Should you continue your equity SIP when the stock market is falling? In this episode of MC Explains, we break down three reasons why continuing your equity SIP during a market correction can be important for long-term investors. Remember, continuing an SIP does not guarantee returns. Equity investments carry market risk and are generally intended for investors with an appropriate long-term investment horizon. Investors should also review their mutual funds on their individual merits and invest according to their financial goals and risk profile. This video is part of MC Explains, an investor education initiative brought to you by Moneycontrol.com and Invesco Mutual Fund.

Improved healthcare facilities are contributing to the region's human capital and overall economic growth.

articles.title: India is Building More Airports Than Singapore, Vietnam & Cambodia Combined
articles.description: India's aviation sector is preparing for an unprecedented takeoff! Speaking at the Routes Asia 2027 curtain raiser, Civil Aviation Minister K. Rammohan Naidu revealed a massive masterplan to make India the world’s third-largest aviation market. The goal? A staggering 130 crore annual passengers and 400 operational airports by the year 2047. To hit these ambitious targets, India is currently developing 66 new airports and plans to build 100 more over the next decade alone. To put that hyper-growth into perspective, that is more new airports than Vietnam, Laos, Cambodia, and Singapore combined! This infrastructure boom aims to make flying radically more inclusive for millions. Are we witnessing the greatest aviation expansion in history? Let us know your thoughts in the comments.
